title: “iHeartRadio and TikTok LIVE Premiere with Anuel AA” to Exclusively Preview New Music From His Upcoming Album, Real Hasta La Muerte 2, Streaming LIVE on TikTok November 5
summary: iHeartMedia is a leading global media and entertainment company specializing in radio, digital, mobile, social, live events and on-demand entertainment.
body_markdown:
*The special will also broadcast on iHeartRadio Spanish Mainstream stations and on iHeartRadio’s digital Rumba station the day the album is released*


**WHAT: “iHeartRadio and TikTok LIVE Premiere with Anuel AA”** to exclusively preview new music and announce the release date for his upcoming album, Real Hasta La Muerte 2, streaming LIVE on TikTok November 5 at 7 p.m. ET. To continue the celebration of the new album throughout the month, iHeartRadio will also broadcast the special the day the album is released on iHeartRadio Spanish Mainstream stations at 7 p.m. local time and on iHeartRadio’s digital Rumba station at 7 p.m. ET.


**WHO:** During the hour-long livestream hosted by Enrique Santos, president of iHeartLatino and iHeartRadio personality, Anuel AA will announce the release date of his upcoming album, preview songs and share inspiration behind the new music. Fans can engage in real-time using TikTok features including polls, custom designed ‘like’ icons, and more that will be integrated throughout the session. Additionally, fans can visit iHeartRadio’s digital[Rumba](https://www.iheart.com/live/rumba-4451) station and use the talkback feature to share their questions with Anuel AA ahead of the show on November 5.


**WHEN:** Fans can tune in live on TikTok on November 5 at 7 p.m. ET. The special will also broadcast the day the album is released on iHeartRadio Spanish Mainstream stations at 7 p.m. local time and on iHeartRadio’s digital Rumba station at 7 p.m. ET. More details on the broadcast to come.


**WHERE:** Fans can tune in live via[@TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@tiktok?lang=en) ,[@Anuel](https://www.tiktok.com/@anuel?lang=en) ,[@iHeartRadio](https://www.tiktok.com/@iheartradio) and[@TikTokLive_US](https://www.tiktok.com/@tiktoklive_us?lang=en) ,[@TikTokLive_latam](https://www.tiktok.com/@tiktoklive_latam?lang=en) ,[@yosoyenrique](https://www.tiktok.com/@yosoyenrique) accounts on November 5 at 7 p.m. The special will also broadcast the day the album is released on iHeartRadio Spanish Mainstream stations at 7 p.m. local time and on iHeartRadio’s digital[Rumba](https://www.iheart.com/live/rumba-4451) station at 7 p.m. ET.
